context: Normalize Path inputs to the Snowflake stage grammar without broadening ordinary local path matching; retain anchored handling for @~, table, named, and qualified stages.
description: Run 30434746317 fails is_snowflake_stage_path(Path('@~/benchbox')) because Windows stringifies Path with backslashes while the stage grammar accepts only forward slashes. The public helper explicitly accepts Path inputs, so behavior is platform-dependent.

preserves.behavior: cloud URIs containing @ and ordinary local paths never classify as Snowflake stages

work_units.evidence: Merged PR #1352 normalizes PurePath separators before Snowflake stage classification; focused current-develop tests passed.
